# WO-607: Online usernames and handles in the profile
Status: queued (in-house, contract)
Vendor: claude
Agent: orchestrator (models) then automation-engineer (matcher) and wizard-packager (screen)
Owner: orchestrator (contract)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Kind: architecture
Tier: deep
Severity: MEDIUM
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner real-data test, stage 1 (search only), qa-security 2026-11-11. Private results are kept outside the repo; this WO is PII-free by rule.

## Goal
There is nowhere to record a person's online usernames or handles: not in `Profile` (`models.py:330-357`), `SetupPerson` (`setup_config.py:64-77`) or the wizard. Several brokers and aggregators list social handles; the owner test could not record any. Without the field the matcher cannot use a handle as a signal, the search-engine checklist cannot suggest searching for it, and a removal letter cannot name it.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. `Profile.usernames: list[str] = []` (contract), schema regenerated, setup file and wizard field ("Usernames you use online, if any"), all optional.
2. Matcher: an exact handle match on a listing counts as one signal (documented in the matcher signal list); never enough alone for CONFIRMED (shared rule 7 unchanged: name + 2 signals).
3. Usernames are PII: encrypted at rest like emails, never in logs/events/exceptions (redaction test), never sent to a broker unless the listing already shows that handle (`shown_fields`, rule 6).
4. Search-engine checklist adds a "search for your username" step when any are set.
5. Tests with fake handles; redaction test proves none reach the log.
